headline: Trump told AP (Monday) he is open to meeting Putin and Xi in China 'even without' Zelensky
dek: Trump open to trilateral with Putin and Xi without Zelensky; Putin proposed it per WSJ, Peskov confirmed talks ongoing, nothing agreed; Zelensky demands Ukraine-inclusive format (G20 December counter-proposal); Sybiha warns exclusion encourages Putin.
sources: Trump (AP interview, Monday); WSJ (original report); Peskov (press confirmation); Rubio; Mao Ning; Zelensky; FM Andrii Sybiha (via Reuters)
fault_line: Peace without Ukraine at the table — end of the war, or Munich 2.0?

sections.what_happened: Trump open to trilateral with Putin and Xi without Zelensky; Putin proposed it per WSJ, Peskov confirmed talks ongoing, nothing agreed; Zelensky demands Ukraine-inclusive format (G20 December counter-proposal); Sybiha warns exclusion encourages Putin.
sections.what_verified: Gulf News, ET, Outlook India, EconoTimes, The Statesman, Hindu BusinessLine, Mezha all carry consistent details; Peskov confirmation via WSJ; Trump quotes direct from AP.
sections.what_disputed: Trump disputes that Ukraine would be sidelined ('I would do it — not so much for Ukraine... denuclearisation'); Peskov: any final settlement would require Kyiv participation; NYT (via tracker): Trump pressing Ukraine to accept Donbas territorial concessions — Zelensky has not accepted.
sections.why_matters: The big-three table: Trump says he'd meet Putin and Xi without Zelensky — Kyiv calls it a trap, Moscow calls it a possibility. The side of truth here is the skepticism: no deal about Ukraine without Ukraine.
sections.context: Background: Ukraine diplomacy — Trump–Putin–Xi APEC summit proposal (Oct 19-20): Trump told AP (Monday) he is open to meeting Putin and Xi in China 'even without' Zelensky ('Anything I can do to end the war, whether somebody's there or not'); WSJ reported Putin proposed the trilateral; Peskov confirmed discussions, 'no clear understanding yet' on meeting or agenda; Rubio aware; China's Mao Ning: no info; Zelensky counter-proposed Ukraine-inclusive trilateral at December G20 in the US; FM Andrii Sybiha: US-Russia-China-only meeting 'would encourage Putin to continue'; APEC Nov 18-19 Shenzhen; Trump said focus would be denuclearization, 'not so much for Ukraine'

totw_analysis: Our read: The big-three table: Trump says he'd meet Putin and Xi without Zelensky — Kyiv calls it a trap, Moscow calls it a possibility. The side of truth here is the skepticism: no deal about Ukraine without Ukraine. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Peace without Ukraine at the table — end of the war, or Munich 2.0?
